screens.title: Grab a pen
paras: This week has important details about Health and Safety inspections. Please take notes as you go.
Complete this Focus by 8:30 PM Wednesday. At the end you'll get a code to email to James.

check.q: What should you do as you read this week's Focus?
options: Skim it once and hope for the best later
Take notes on the important details
Read it out loud to your roommate
Skip straight to the code at the end

screens.title: Inspections: Wednesday, November 11 at 8:30 PM
paras: **Every RA needs to be there.** We'll meet at 8:30 PM in our team meeting classroom and head out to the floors from there.

check.q: When do we meet for inspections?

fields.label: Date
options: Wednesday, November 4
Monday, November 9
Tuesday, November 10
Wednesday, November 11
Thursday, November 12

screens.title: Your floor and your partner
paras: You'll inspect in pairs, and nobody inspects their own floor. This protects you from any accusation of favoritism or bias, and it means you won't have to document your own residents.

check.q: Why doesn't anyone inspect their own floor?
options: Because your own floor gets a free pass
So your residents can't bribe you
To protect you from accusations of bias
Because James likes to keep you guessing

screens.title: Entering a room
list: Knock again and announce, just as loudly: "RA, Health and Safety Inspections!" Then wait a few seconds.
Knock again and say "RA, keying in." Unlock the door, open it a couple of inches, and announce "RA, entering the room."
Greet them and explain that you need to come in for Health and Safety inspections.
after: **Suggestion:** one partner stays at the door and keeps it open while the other goes in to look around.

check.q: You've knocked and announced twice with no answer. What's next?
options: Assume it's empty and walk right in without a word
Slide a note under the door and come back next week
Knock, say "RA, keying in," then enter as trained
Call the resident's mom and ask for her permission

screens.title: Paper first, then Roompact
paras: Each pair gets a printed roster for its floor, with every room listed. The paper roster is mandatory.

**James strongly recommends** doing all of your checks on paper first. Then come back to the classroom to submit your Roompact forms and incident reports together. The digital forms are hard to fill out on a phone as you go.

options: Paper roster first, then Roompact in the classroom
Roompact on your phone at every single door you visit
Incident reports first, then the paper roster after
Memorize every room and type it all up tomorrow night

screens.title: Submit a Roompact form for EVERY room
paras: No issues? Nobody home? You still submit a form. In each section, check what you saw or check "No concerns were observed."
Be specific in your notes: "two used candles on the left desk," not just "candles."

check.q: A room has no issues. What do you do?
options: Skip it entirely, since there's nothing to report
Draw a smiley face on the paper roster and move on
Submit it and check "No concerns were observed"
Only submit one if a resident happened to be home

screens.title: What you're looking for
list: Alcohol, high-risk drinking gear (beer funnels, beer pong tables), drugs or paraphernalia
Candles or incense, smoking, covered smoke detectors or sprinklers, halogen or multiheaded lamps, extension cords, prohibited appliances, blocked doorways
At least 24 inches from the ceiling; no more than half of a surface; not covering switches or outlets
Damage, excess trash, pests, unapproved pets, removed window screens, weapons

check.q: How far from the ceiling do posters and tapestries need to be?
options: 6 inches
12 inches
24 inches
Touching is fine

screens.title: Photos and confiscated items
paras: **Take a photo of anything you'll document** in Roompact or an incident report.

Confiscated items, like candles, incense, space heaters, toasters, air fryers, hot plates, and waffle irons, get a strip of masking tape labeled with the room number and the resident's name if you know it.

check.q: You confiscate a waffle iron. What goes on it?
options: A sticky note with your own name and phone number
Masking tape with the room and resident's name
A Roompact QR code and a handwritten thank-you card
Nothing at all; just carry it out under your arm

screens.title: What we're not flagging, and microwaves
paras: **Don't flag curtains, refrigerators, or shot glasses.**

Microwaves must have an internal smoke detector and automatic shutoff. If one doesn't, check the microwave box on the form and let the resident know if they're there. We're noting these, not taking them.
Unsure? Take a photo, note it, and James will decide.

check.q: You find a regular microwave with no smoke detector or auto shutoff. What do you do?
options: Pop some popcorn to test it, then move on to the next
Carry it all the way down to the RD office yourself
Unplug it and hide it in the closet so nobody notices
Check the microwave box and tell the resident

screens.title: Inspections, in short
list: Wednesday, November 11, 8:30 PM in the classroom
Your assigned floor, with your partner
Knock and announce twice, then "RA, keying in" and "RA, entering the room"
Paper roster for every room first, then Roompact and IRs back in the classroom
A Roompact form for every room, issue or not
Photos of anything documented; tape and label anything confiscated

check.q: Which rooms get a Roompact form?
options: Only rooms with an obvious issue
Every room, issue or not
Only rooms where someone is home
Only rooms on your own floor

screens.title: Meeting times: 8:30 PM this semester, 8:00 PM in the spring
paras: **This semester, every team meeting starts at 8:30 PM.** James moved it back 30 minutes because some RAs had class conflicts they couldn't fix this term.

**Next semester, team meetings go back to 8:00 PM** every Wednesday, and every RA needs to be there on time. When you register for spring classes, make sure you're **out of class by 7:45 PM on Wednesdays.**

check.q: This semester team meetings start at 8:30 PM. When do you need to be out of class on Wednesdays next semester?
options: By 6:00 PM
By 7:45 PM
By 8:30 PM, same as now
Anytime; just show up late

screens.title: Book your 1:1s by Wednesday night
paras: Please book **at least two** "RA 1:1 with James" times for the rest of the semester by **Wednesday, November 4 at 10:00 PM**. You're welcome to book as many as you'd like. Happy to chat!
Please be logged into your syr.edu account when you book, so each 1:1 shows up on your Outlook calendar.

options: Just one, and only if James asks twice
Exactly three, no more and no less
At least two, more if you'd like
None; James can read your mind
